group.dissolve.title: Dissolve group?
group.dissolve.text: The group “{name}” will be removed. The hosts are kept.
group.error.empty: The name must not be empty.
group.error.brackets: Square brackets and line breaks are not allowed in the name.
gd.name: Name
gd.hint: Type to search, ↓ shows all hosts, Enter adds, Backspace removes the last one. Several names can be pasted at once. The hosts are moved together in the file, in their current order, to the position of the first one.
gd.changes.intro: Moving the hosts together changes effective values – in ssh the first value found wins:
settings.title: Settings
settings.backup.hint_html: On the first save per session, <file>.bak-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS is created next to the file.
settings.keep.hint: 0 = keep all. Older backups are deleted after a new one has been created.
settings.readError: The file could not be read: {error}
eff.empty_html: Enter a host to see the effective configuration (like ssh -G).
eff.noOptions: No options set – ssh only uses its defaults.
text.info: Edit the file directly. Switching back to the editor parses the text again.
block.delete.title: Delete block?
editor.global.title: Global options
editor.global.sub: start of file, before the first Host
editor.global.explain_html: Options before the first Host/Match apply to all connections. Because ssh uses the first value found for every option, they take precedence over all host blocks. Cumulative options such as IdentityFile are added. Defaults that individual hosts may override belong in a Host * block at the end of the file.
editor.up: Up (Alt+↑) – at a group edge: leave/enter the group
editor.down: Down (Alt+↓) – at a group edge: leave/enter the group
editor.delete.title: Delete block
editor.hint.host_html: Several aliases share these options. Wildcards * ?, negation with !pattern. For every option the first block that sets it wins – the order matters.
editor.globalHost.atEnd_html: This Host * block applies to all hosts. It is at the end: its values are defaults that more specific blocks can override.
editor.globalHost.notAtEnd_html: This Host * block applies to all hosts. It is at position {position}: its values take precedence over all later blocks. Move it to the end for overridable defaults.
conflict.title: File has changed
conflict.text: The file was changed outside GoSSHpher since it was loaded. Overwrite it or reload it (your changes are lost)?
discard.title: Unsaved changes
issue.group.duplicate: The group “{group}” occurs more than once in the file. Group names must be unique – rename it or move the blocks together.
issue.pattern.uppercase: Pattern “{pattern}” contains upper-case letters. ssh compares with the lower-cased host name, so the pattern never matches.
issue.host.onlyNegated: Only negated patterns: this block never matches.
issue.host.samePatterns: Same patterns as block {block}. Only cumulative options (e.g. IdentityFile) add anything from here.
issue.option.hostMatch: “{key}” is not allowed as an option, create a separate block instead.
issue.option.duplicate: “{key}” occurs more than once in this block; only the first value (line {line} of the block) applies.
issue.shadowed.hint.order: In ssh the first value found wins: move this block further up or remove the earlier value.
issue.shadowed.hint.wildcard: In ssh the first value found wins: general blocks (Host *, wildcards, global options) with overridable defaults belong at the end of the file.
issue.remoteCommand.noTTY: For “{host}”, RemoteCommand starts a shell, but RequestTTY is not “force”/“yes”. Without a TTY the shell is not interactive.
note.match.offline: “{attr} {arg}” cannot be evaluated offline and counts as not matching
note.match.notEvaluated: Match blocks with exec/localnetwork/… were not evaluated.
kw.AddKeysToAgent: Add keys to ssh-agent automatically after their first use.
kw.AddressFamily: Address family to use for the connection.
kw.BatchMode: No password or passphrase prompts (for scripts).
kw.BindAddress: Local source address of the connection.
kw.CanonicalDomains: Domains appended during host name canonicalization.
kw.CanonicalizeFallbackLocal: Continue the normal lookup if canonicalization fails.
kw.CanonicalizeMaxDots: Maximum number of dots for canonicalization.
kw.CASignatureAlgorithms: Allowed signature algorithms for CA certificates.
kw.CertificateFile: User certificate (may be given several times).
kw.CheckHostIP: Also check the host's IP address in known_hosts.
kw.ConnectTimeout: Timeout for establishing the connection, in seconds.
kw.ControlPath: Path of the control socket, e.g. ~/.ssh/cm-%r@%h:%p.
kw.ControlPersist: Keep the master connection open in the background.
kw.DynamicForward: SOCKS proxy on a local port (may be given several times).
kw.ForkAfterAuthentication: Go to the background after authentication (-f).
kw.ForwardAgent: Forward the ssh-agent to the server.
kw.GatewayPorts: Allow remote hosts to connect to locally forwarded ports.
kw.HostKeyAlias: Alias used for the known_hosts check.
kw.Hostname: Real host name or IP address to connect to (%h = the given name).
kw.IdentitiesOnly: Only use the configured IdentityFiles, not all keys of the agent.
kw.IdentityFile: Private key (may be given several times, all are tried).
kw.IgnoreUnknown: Ignore unknown options matching these patterns.
kw.Include: Include further configuration files (glob, relative to ~/.ssh).
kw.KnownHostsCommand: Command that returns additional known_hosts entries.
kw.LocalCommand: Local command run after a successful connection (requires PermitLocalCommand).
kw.LocalForward: Local port forwarding: [bind:]port host:hostport (may be given several times).
kw.LogVerbose: Verbose logging for specific source files or functions.
kw.NoHostAuthenticationForLocalhost: Disable host key checking for localhost.
kw.ProxyCommand: Command used to connect to the server (e.g. nc, tunnel).
kw.ProxyJump: Jump via one or more bastion hosts: [user@]host[:port][,...].
kw.PubkeyAcceptedAlgorithms: Allowed algorithms for public key authentication.
kw.RekeyLimit: Amount of data or time before the keys are renegotiated.
kw.RemoteCommand: Command executed on the server after login.
kw.RemoteForward: Remote port forwarding (may be given several times).
kw.RequestTTY: Request a pseudo terminal (force/yes for RemoteCommand with a shell).
kw.SendEnv: Send local environment variables to the server (may be given several times).
kw.ServerAliveCountMax: Number of unanswered keepalives before disconnecting.
kw.SetEnv: Set environment variables on the server (may be given several times).
kw.StreamLocalBindUnlink: Remove existing Unix sockets before binding.
kw.StrictHostKeyChecking: Handling of unknown or changed host keys.
kw.UpdateHostKeys: Accept additional host keys of the server.
kw.VisualHostKey: Show ASCII art of the host key.
editor.header.title: File header
editor.header.explain_html: Comments at the start of the file, before the first Host/Match. Options added here apply to all connections and take precedence over all host blocks.
error.execUnknown: The command does not occur in this configuration: {command}
eff.expanded.title: as ssh uses it when connecting (%-tokens, ${ENV} and ~ substituted)
eff.exec.title: Match exec
eff.exec.hint: GoSSHpher does not run these commands on its own. Choose the result to assume, or run a command once.
exec.confirm.title: Run command?
exec.confirm.text:
GoSSHpher runs this command in your shell, as ssh would when connecting to {host}. Its result is used for the evaluation.

{command}
note.match.execAssumed: “exec {command}” was not run and is assumed to fail.
error.terminalHost: Cannot connect to “{host}”: a single host name without wildcards is needed.
error.noTerminal: No terminal program found. Set one in the settings.
terminal.failed: ssh exited with status {status}. Press Enter to close this window.
settings.terminal.hint: Program that opens the ssh connection, e.g. “kitty”, “gnome-terminal --” or “konsole -e”. The command to run is appended. Empty = detect automatically.
menu.connect.disabled: Only for Host blocks with a host name without wildcards
connect.unsaved.title: Save changes first?
connect.unsaved.text: ssh reads the file from disk. Unsaved changes are not used for this connection.
update.dismiss.title: Hide this notice until the next release
settings.updateCheck.hint: Asks GitHub (api.github.com) once per start whether a newer release exists. No data besides the request itself is sent.
